_about: E-Invoice canonical layer - what each canonical field is called in the raw E-Invoice tab 'b2b, sez, de' (spec: docs/EINV_CANONICAL_SPEC.md). The tab has a title, ONE heading row, then a period-banner row ('Financial Year: .. | Tax Period: ..') per month with that month's invoices under it. Headings are compared after lower-casing and stripping every non-alphanumeric character. 'exact' = accepted spellings (first is the canonical one, the rest are aliases); 'contains' = a fragment of the heading; 'type': 'num' = converted to a number (blank cell = 0), 'raw' = kept exactly as in the source (text, dates, identifiers); 'required': true = the file is rejected with a plain message if the column cannot be found. To support a renamed portal heading add its spelling to the right field's 'exact' list. 'absent_ok': true = the portal download normally does not have this column, so its absence is not reported. 'cancelled_values' = status texts that mean the e-invoice was cancelled. 'cancel_date' only accepts headings that really say the invoice was cancelled on that date; the portal's 'GSTR-1 auto-population/ deletion upon cancellation date' column is filled for VALID invoices too, so it is kept separately as 'autopop_date' and never reported as a cancellation date.

legal_name: legal name of the registered person
